02 / THE WORKFLOW

A simple request.
A visible path to done.

The model reasons locally. Tools take action. You stay connected through questions, approvals, and results.

  1. 01

    Give it a goal

    Message your Telegram bot or start a task from the Tora badge in Edge.

    NATURAL LANGUAGE IN
  2. 02

    Let it work

    The local model chooses tools, follows the task, and asks when information is missing.

    REASON → ACT → OBSERVE
  3. 03

    Review the result

    Receive the report, source links, and available screenshots or generated artifacts.

    EVIDENCE BACK TO YOU
◇
Local reasoning. Clear boundaries.

Inference runs through Ollama on your computer. Telegram carries messages and reports; browser tasks visit external sites; optional Gmail access uses Google's API.

Tora AI for Windows

Developer preview · Python source

The complete local agent, setup helper, example configuration, and Edge extension. Models are downloaded separately with Ollama.

Download agent source ↓
Edge extension ZIP ↗Setup guide ↓
YOU'LL NEED
  • Windows 11 + Microsoft Edge
  • Python 3.11+ and Ollama
  • Your own Telegram bot
  • Memory and storage for your chosen model

Source package, not a standalone installer. macOS and Linux desktop control are not supported by this Windows workflow.

Up and running.

WINDOWS / POWERSHELL
  1. 1

    Extract and set up

    Open the extracted Tora-AI folder in a terminal. The helper creates an isolated Python environment.

    python scripts/setup.py
  2. 2

    Connect your model and bot

    Pull the model, add your bot token to .env, and fill in your profile. Follow the setup guide to pair your Telegram chat.

    ollama pull qwen3-coder:30b
  3. 3

    Start Tora

    Keep your computer awake. Send your bot a small task, such as creating a text file in your chosen workspace.

    .venv\Scripts\python.exe main.py
